1.english_reference: And it came to pass the same year , in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֣י בַּ שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ הִ֗יא בְּ רֵאשִׁית֙ מַמְלֶ֨כֶת֙ צִדְקִיָּ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ τετάρτῳ ἔτει Σεδεκία βασιλέως Ἰούδα
traditions.VUL: Et factum est in anno illo , in princípio regni Sedecíæ regis Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: And it came to pass the same year , in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah ,

1.english_reference: in the fourth year , [ and ] in the fifth month ,

traditions.WLC: ב שנת הָֽ רְבִעִ֔ית בַּ חֹ֖דֶשׁ הַ חֲמִישִׁ֑י
traditions.LXX: ἐν μηνὶ τῷ πέμπτῳ
traditions.VUL: in anno quarto , in mense quinto ,
traditions.KJV: in the fourth year , [ and ] in the fifth month , [ that ]

1.english_reference: [ that ] Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet , which [ was ] of Gibeon , spake unto me

traditions.WLC: אָמַ֣ר אֵלַ֡ י חֲנַנְיָה֩ בֶן עַזּ֨וּר הַ נָּבִ֜יא אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִ גִּבְעוֹן֙
traditions.LXX: εἶπέν μοι Ἁνανίας υἱὸς Ἀζὼρ ὁ ψευδοπροφήτης ἀπὸ Γαβαὼν
traditions.VUL: dixit ad me Hananías fílius Azur , prophéta de Gábaon ,
traditions.KJV: Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet , which [ was ] of Gibeon , spake unto me

1.english_reference: in the house of the LORD , in the presence of the priests and of all the people ,

traditions.WLC: בְּ בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה לְ עֵינֵ֧י הַ כֹּהֲנִ֛ים וְ כָל הָ עָ֖ם
traditions.LXX: ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου κατ᾽ ὀφθαλμοὺς τῶν ἱερέων καὶ παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ
traditions.VUL: in domo Dómini , coram sacerdótibus et omni pópulo ,
traditions.KJV: in the house of the LORD , in the presence of the priests and of all the people ,

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: λέγων
traditions.VUL: dicens :
traditions.KJV: saying ,

2.english_reference: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts , the God of Israel , saying ,

traditions.WLC: כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ אמֹ֑ר
traditions.LXX: Οὕτως εἶπεν Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus exercítuum , Deus Israel :
traditions.KJV: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts , the God of Israel , saying ,

2.english_reference: I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon .

traditions.WLC: שָׁבַ֞רְתִּי אֶת עֹ֖ל מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל
traditions.LXX: Συνέτριψα τὸν ζυγὸν τοῦ βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος .
traditions.VUL: Contrívi iugum regis Babylónis .
traditions.KJV: I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon .

3.english_reference: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of the LORD ’S house ,

traditions.WLC: בְּ ע֣וֹד שְׁנָתַ֣יִם יָמִ֗ים אֲנִ֤י מֵשִׁיב֙ אֶל הַ מָּק֣וֹם הַ זֶּ֔ה אֶֽת כָּל כְּלֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ἔτι δύο ἔτη ἡμερῶν καὶ ἐγὼ ἀποστρέψω εἰς τὸν τόπον τοῦτον τὰ σκεύη οἴκου Κυρίου
traditions.VUL: Adhuc duo anni diérum , et ego reférri fáciam ad locum istum ómnia vasa domus Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of the LORD ’S house ,

3.english_reference: that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place , and carried them to Babylon :

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֨ר לָקַ֜ח נְבוּכַדנֶאצַּ֤ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶל֙ מִן הַ מָּק֣וֹם הַ זֶּ֔ה וַ יְבִיאֵ֖ ם בָּבֶֽל
traditions.VUL: quæ tulit Nabuchodónosor rex Babylónis de loco isto , et tránstulit ea in Babylónem .
traditions.KJV: that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place , and carried them to Babylon :

4.english_reference: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah , with all the captives of Judah , that went into Babylon ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת יְכָנְיָ֣ה בֶן יְהוֹיָקִ֣ים מֶֽלֶךְ יְ֠הוּדָה וְ אֶת כָּל גָּל֨וּת יְהוּדָ֜ה הַ בָּאִ֣ים בָּבֶ֗לָ ה אֲנִ֥י מֵשִׁ֛יב אֶל הַ מָּק֥וֹם הַ זֶּ֖ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ἰεχονίαν καὶ τὴν ἀποικίαν Ἰούδα ,
traditions.VUL: Et Iechoníam fílium Ióakim regem Iuda , et omnem transmigratiónem Iuda , qui ingréssi sunt in Babylónem , ego convértam ad locum istum ,
traditions.KJV: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah , with all the captives of Judah , that went into Babylon ,

traditions.WLC: נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.VUL: ait Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: saith the LORD :

4.english_reference: for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon .

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י אֶשְׁבֹּ֔ר אֶת עֹ֖ל מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל
traditions.LXX: ὅτι συντρίψω τὸν ζυγὸν βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος .
traditions.VUL: cónteram enim iugum regis Babylónis .
traditions.KJV: for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon .

5.english_reference: Then the prophet Jeremiah said unto the prophet Hananiah

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יִרְמְיָ֣ה הַ נָּבִ֔יא אֶל חֲנַנְיָ֖ה הַ נָּבִ֑יא
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Ἰερεμίας πρὸς Ἁνανίαν
traditions.VUL: Et dixit Ieremías prophéta ad Hananíam prophétam ,
traditions.KJV: Then the prophet Jeremiah said unto the prophet Hananiah

5.english_reference: in the presence of the priests , and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: לְ עֵינֵ֤י הַ כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וּ לְ עֵינֵ֣י כָל הָ עָ֔ם הָ עֹמְדִ֖ים בְּ בֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: κατ᾽ ὀφθαλμοὺς παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ κατ᾽ ὀφθαλμοὺς τῶν ἱερέων τῶν ἑστηκότων ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: in óculis sacerdótum , et in óculis omnis pópuli , qui stabat in domo Dómini :
traditions.KJV: in the presence of the priests , and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of the LORD ,

6.english_reference: Even the prophet Jeremiah said , Amen : the LORD do so :

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יִרְמְיָ֣ה הַ נָּבִ֔יא אָמֵ֕ן כֵּ֖ן יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Ἰερεμίας Ἀληθῶς οὕτω ποιήσαι Κύριος ·
traditions.VUL: et ait Ieremías prophéta : Amen , sic fáciat Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: Even the prophet Jeremiah said , Amen : the LORD do so :

6.english_reference: the LORD perform thy words which thou hast prophesied ,

traditions.WLC: יָקֵ֤ם יְהוָה֙ אֶת דְּבָרֶ֔י ךָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִבֵּ֗אתָ
traditions.LXX: στήσαι τὸν λόγον σου ὃν σὺ προφητεύεις ,
traditions.VUL: súscitet Dóminus verba tua , quæ prophetásti :
traditions.KJV: the LORD perform thy words which thou hast prophesied ,

6.english_reference: to bring again the vessels of the LORD ’S house , and all that is carried away captive , from Babylon into this place .

traditions.WLC: לְ הָשִׁ֞יב כְּלֵ֤י בֵית יְהוָה֙ וְ כָל הַ גּוֹלָ֔ה מִ בָּבֶ֖ל אֶל הַ מָּק֥וֹם הַ זֶּֽה
traditions.LXX: τοῦ ἐπιστρέψαι τὰ σκεύη οἴκου Κυρίου καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν ἀποικίαν ἐκ Βαβυλῶνος εἰς τὸν τόπον τοῦτον .
traditions.VUL: ut referántur vasa in domum Dómini , et omnis transmigrátio de Babylóne ad locum istum .
traditions.KJV: to bring again the vessels of the LORD ’S house , and all that is carried away captive , from Babylon into this place .

7.english_reference: Nevertheless hear thou now this word that I speak in thine ears ,

traditions.WLC: אַךְ שְׁמַֽע נָא֙ הַ דָּבָ֣ר הַ זֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י דֹּבֵ֣ר בְּ אָזְנֶ֑י ךָ
traditions.LXX: πλὴν ἀκούσατε τὸν λόγον Κυρίου ὃν ἐγὼ λέγω εἰς τὰ ὧτα ὑμῶν
traditions.VUL: Verúmtamen audi verbum hoc , quod ego loquor in áuribus tuis ,
traditions.KJV: Nevertheless hear thou now this word that I speak in thine ears ,

7.english_reference: and in the ears of all the people ;

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ אָזְנֵ֖י כָּל הָ עָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἰς τὰ ὦτα παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ
traditions.VUL: et in áuribus univérsi pópuli :
traditions.KJV: and in the ears of all the people ;

8.english_reference: The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old

traditions.WLC: הַ נְּבִיאִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָי֧וּ לְ פָנַ֛ י וּ לְ פָנֶ֖י ךָ מִן הָֽ עוֹלָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: Οἱ προφῆται οἱ γεγονότες πρότεροί μου καὶ πρότεροι ὑμῶν ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος ,
traditions.VUL: Prophétæ , qui fuérunt ante me et ante te ab inítio ,
traditions.KJV: The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old

8.english_reference: prophesied both against many countries , and against great kingdoms ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּנָּ֨בְא֜וּ אֶל אֲרָצ֤וֹת רַבּוֹת֙ וְ עַל מַמְלָכ֣וֹת גְּדֹל֔וֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπροφήτευσαν ἐπὶ γῆς πολλῆς καὶ ἐπὶ βασιλείας μεγάλας
traditions.VUL: et prophetavérunt super terras multas , et super regna magna
traditions.KJV: prophesied both against many countries , and against great kingdoms ,

8.english_reference: of war , and of evil , and of pestilence .

traditions.WLC: לְ מִלְחָמָ֖ה וּ לְ רָעָ֥ה וּ לְ דָֽבֶר
traditions.LXX: εἰς πόλεμον ·
traditions.VUL: de prœ́lio , et de afflictióne , et de fame .
traditions.KJV: of war , and of evil , and of pestilence .

9.english_reference: The prophet which prophesieth of peace ,

traditions.WLC: הַ נָּבִ֕יא אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִנָּבֵ֖א לְ שָׁל֑וֹם
traditions.LXX: ὁ προφήτης ὁ προφητεύσας εἰς εἰρήνην ,
traditions.VUL: Prophéta , qui vaticinátus est pacem :
traditions.KJV: The prophet which prophesieth of peace ,

9.english_reference: when the word of the prophet shall come to pass ,

traditions.WLC: בְּ בֹא֙ דְּבַ֣ר הַ נָּבִ֗יא
traditions.LXX: ἐλθόντος τοῦ λόγου
traditions.VUL: cum vénerit verbum eius ,
traditions.KJV: when the word of the prophet shall come to pass , [ then ]

9.english_reference: [ then ] shall the prophet be known , that the LORD hath truly sent him .

traditions.WLC: יִוָּדַע֙ הַ נָּבִ֔יא אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָח֥ וֹ יְהוָ֖ה בֶּ אֱמֶֽת
traditions.LXX: γνώσονται τὸν προφήτην ὃν ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοῖς Κύριος ἐν πίστει .
traditions.VUL: sciétur prophéta , quem misit Dóminus in veritáte .
traditions.KJV: shall the prophet be known , that the LORD hath truly sent him .

10.english_reference: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah ’s neck ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקַּ֞ח חֲנַנְיָ֤ה הַ נָּבִיא֙ אֶת הַ מּוֹטָ֔ה מֵ עַ֕ל צַוַּ֖אר יִרְמְיָ֣ה הַ נָּבִ֑יא
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔλαβεν Ἁνανίας ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ τοὺς κλοιοὺς ἀπὸ τοῦ τραχήλου Ἰερεμίου
traditions.VUL: Et tulit Hananías prophéta caténam de collo Ieremíæ prophétæ ,
traditions.KJV: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah ’s neck ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ συνέτριψεν αὐτούς .
traditions.VUL: et confrégit eam .
traditions.KJV: and brake it .

11.english_reference: And Hananiah spake in the presence of all the people , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר חֲנַנְיָה֩ לְ עֵינֵ֨י כָל הָ עָ֜ם לֵ אמֹ֗ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Ἁνανίας κατ᾽ ὀφθαλμοὺς παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ λέγων
traditions.VUL: Et ait Hananías in conspéctu omnis pópuli , dicens :
traditions.KJV: And Hananiah spake in the presence of all the people , saying ,

traditions.WLC: כֹּה֮ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָה֒
traditions.LXX: Οὕτως εἶπεν Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the LORD ;

11.english_reference: Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon

traditions.WLC: כָּ֣כָה אֶשְׁבֹּ֞ר אֶת עֹ֣ל נְבֻֽכַדְנֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֗ל
traditions.LXX: Οὕτως συντρίψω τὸν ζυγὸν βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος
traditions.VUL: Sic confríngam iugum Nabuchodónosor regis Babylónis ,
traditions.KJV: Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon

11.english_reference: from the neck of all nations within the space of two full years .

traditions.WLC: בְּ עוֹד֙ שְׁנָתַ֣יִם יָמִ֔ים מֵ עַ֕ל צַוַּ֖אר כָּל הַ גּוֹיִ֑ם
traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ τραχήλων πάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν .
traditions.VUL: post duos annos diérum de collo ómnium géntium .
traditions.KJV: from the neck of all nations within the space of two full years .

11.english_reference: And the prophet Jeremiah went his way .

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֛לֶךְ יִרְמְיָ֥ה הַ נָּבִ֖יא לְ דַרְכּֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ᾤχετο Ἰερεμίας εἰς τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτοῦ .
traditions.KJV: And the prophet Jeremiah went his way .

traditions.VUL: Et ábiit Ieremías prophéta in viam suam .

12.english_reference: Then the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah [ the prophet ] ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς Ἰερεμίαν
traditions.VUL: Et factum est verbum Dómini ad Ieremíam ,
traditions.KJV: Then the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah [ the prophet ] ,

12.english_reference: after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah ,

traditions.WLC: אַ֠חֲרֵי שְׁב֞וֹר חֲנַנְיָ֤ה הַ נָּבִיא֙ אֶת הַ מּוֹטָ֔ה מֵ עַ֗ל צַוַּ֛אר יִרְמְיָ֥ה הַ נָּבִ֖יא
traditions.LXX: μετὰ τὸ συντρίψαι Ἁνανίαν τοὺς κλοιοὺς ἀπὸ τοῦ τραχήλου αὐτοῦ
traditions.VUL: postquam confrégit Hananías prophéta caténam de collo Ieremíæ prophétæ ,
traditions.KJV: after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah ,

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: λέγων
traditions.VUL: dicens :
traditions.KJV: saying ,

traditions.WLC: הָלוֹךְ֩ וְ אָמַרְתָּ֨ אֶל חֲנַנְיָ֜ה לֵ אמֹ֗ר
traditions.LXX: Βάδιζε καὶ εἰπὸν πρὸς Ἁνανίαν λέγων
traditions.VUL: Vade , et dices Hananíæ :
traditions.KJV: Go and tell Hananiah , saying ,

traditions.WLC: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: Οὕτως εἶπεν Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the LORD ;

13.english_reference: Thou hast broken the yokes of wood ;

traditions.WLC: מוֹטֹ֥ת עֵ֖ץ שָׁבָ֑רְתָּ
traditions.LXX: Κλοιοὺς ξυλίνους συνέτριψας ,
traditions.VUL: Caténas lígneas contrivísti :
traditions.KJV: Thou hast broken the yokes of wood ;

13.english_reference: but thou shalt make for them yokes of iron .

traditions.WLC: וְ עָשִׂ֥יתָ תַחְתֵּי הֶ֖ן מֹט֥וֹת בַּרְזֶֽל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ποιήσω ἀντ᾽ αὐτῶν κλοιοὺς σιδηροῦς .
traditions.VUL: et fácies pro eis caténas férreas .
traditions.KJV: but thou shalt make for them yokes of iron .

14.english_reference: For thus saith the LORD of hosts , the God of Israel ;

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י כֹֽה אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οὕτως εἶπεν Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Quia hæc dicit Dóminus exercítuum , Deus Israel :
traditions.KJV: For thus saith the LORD of hosts , the God of Israel ;

14.english_reference: I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations ,

traditions.WLC: עֹ֣ל בַּרְזֶ֡ל נָתַ֜תִּי עַל צַוַּ֣אר כָּל הַ גּוֹיִ֣ם הָ אֵ֗לֶּה
traditions.LXX: Ζυγὸν σιδηροῦν ἔθηκα ἐπὶ τὸν τράχηλον πάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν
traditions.VUL: Iugum férreum pósui super collum cunctárum géntium istárum ,
traditions.KJV: I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations ,

14.english_reference: that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon ; and they shall serve him :

traditions.WLC: לַ עֲבֹ֛ד אֶת נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל וַ עֲבָדֻ֑ הוּ
traditions.LXX: ἐργάζεσθαι τῷ βασιλεῖ Βαβυλῶνος .
traditions.VUL: ut sérviant Nabuchodónosor regi Babylónis , et sérvient ei :
traditions.KJV: that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon ; and they shall serve him :

14.english_reference: and I have given him the beasts of the field also .

traditions.WLC: וְ גַ֛ם אֶת חַיַּ֥ת הַ שָּׂדֶ֖ה נָתַ֥תִּי לֽ וֹ
traditions.VUL: ínsuper et béstias terræ dedi ei .
traditions.KJV: and I have given him the beasts of the field also .

15.english_reference: Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֧ה הַ נָּבִ֛יא אֶל חֲנַנְיָ֥ה הַ נָּבִ֖יא
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Ἰερεμίας τῷ Ἁνανίᾳ
traditions.VUL: Et dixit Ieremías prophéta ad Hananíam prophétam :
traditions.KJV: Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet ,

traditions.WLC: שְׁמַֽע נָ֣א חֲנַנְיָ֑ה
traditions.VUL: Audi Hananía :
traditions.KJV: Hear now , Hananiah ;

15.english_reference: The LORD hath not sent thee ;

traditions.WLC: לֹֽא שְׁלָחֲ ךָ֣ יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: Οὐκ ἀπέσταλκέν σε Κύριος ,
traditions.VUL: non misit te Dóminus ,
traditions.KJV: The LORD hath not sent thee ;

15.english_reference: but thou makest this people to trust in a lie .

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתָּ֗ה הִבְטַ֛חְתָּ אֶת הָ עָ֥ם הַ זֶּ֖ה עַל שָֽׁקֶר
traditions.LXX: καὶ πεποιθέναι ἐποίησας τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον ἐπ᾽ ἀδίκῳ .
traditions.VUL: et tu confídere fecísti pópulum istum in mendácio .
traditions.KJV: but thou makest this people to trust in a lie .

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο οὕτως εἶπεν Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Idcírco hæc dicit Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: Therefore thus saith the LORD ;

16.english_reference: Behold , I will cast thee from off the face of the earth :

traditions.WLC: הִנְ נִי֙ מְשַֽׁלֵּֽחֲ ךָ֔ מֵ עַ֖ל פְּנֵ֣י הָ אֲדָמָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐξαποστέλλω σε ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς γῆς ·
traditions.VUL: Ecce ego mittam te a fácie terræ :
traditions.KJV: Behold , I will cast thee from off the face of the earth :

traditions.WLC: הַ שָּׁנָה֙ אַתָּ֣ה מֵ֔ת
traditions.LXX: τούτῳ τῷ ἐνιαυτῷ ἀποθανῇ .
traditions.VUL: hoc anno moriéris :
traditions.KJV: this year thou shalt die ,

16.english_reference: because thou hast taught rebellion against the LORD .

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי סָרָ֥ה דִבַּ֖רְתָּ אֶל יְהוָֽה
traditions.VUL: advérsum enim Dóminum locútus es .
traditions.KJV: because thou hast taught rebellion against the LORD .

17.english_reference: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month .

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֛מָת חֲנַנְיָ֥ה הַ נָּבִ֖יא בַּ שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ הִ֑יא בַּ חֹ֖דֶשׁ הַ שְּׁבִיעִֽי
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπέθανεν ἐν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ ἑβδόμῳ .
traditions.VUL: Et mórtuus est Hananías prophéta in anno illo , mense séptimo .
traditions.KJV: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month .
